summary: Tested all new image tools + PDF preview enhancements end-to-end. Backend /api/image/compress passes 3 pytest cases (compress reduces size, rejects text file, max_width resize). Frontend UI: homepage 'Image tools' chip + all 4 new tool cards visible, navigation works. CompressTool: preview shows, quality=60 compresses 1.37MB -> 504KB (saved 64%), download smaller. CropTool: editor renders, 1:1 preset yields square dims (1200x1200), custom 600x600 lock produces exact 600x600 output, downloads OK. Remove-BG (single quota-preserving run): preview shows, real API call returns transparent PNG, download works (scan_no_bg.png). PhotoText: canvas preview renders, name/DOB/position/font/color/size/outline controls work, JPG download (~1.2MB) succeeds. File preview on PDF tools: protect-pdf shows first-page preview after PDF upload; merge-pdf shows per-file thumbnails (2 blob/data imgs) for 2 uploaded PDFs.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageToolPage.jsx is ~465 lines and contains 4 tool components + shells. Consider splitting per-tool for maintainability (soft, not blocking).
CropTool state 'customW'/'customH' compared with '> 0' relies on JS string-to-number coercion; works but explicit Number() cast would be clearer.

Compress endpoint falls back to original bytes when compression yields larger output, but returns file.content_type which could be None for unusual uploads - guarded with 'application/octet-stream' fallback, OK.
RemoveBgTool has no client-side pre-check for image type (relies on server 415). Minor UX improvement possible.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 executed; remove-bg intentionally skipped to preserve quota, verified via UI once)

seed_data_creation: None. Test images (/tmp/big.jpg, /tmp/scan.jpg) and PDFs (/tmp/text.pdf, /tmp/scan.pdf) already present from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: File-input on tool pages is a hidden <input type=file> (class='hidden'). Use page.locator('input[type=file]').first.set_input_files(path) instead of wait_for_selector visible. remove.bg has finite monthly quota - do not repeatedly invoke /api/image/remove-bg; backend test file has the case @pytest.mark.skip. Regression test for PDF-to-Word failed here only due to nav dropdown intercepting the 'Convert PDF' text match in Playwright; on-page button still works.
